title: Workers by Industrial Shed, River Rock Mound - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A low-angle black-and-white snapshot showing a towering foreground mound of rounded river boulders or cobblestones leading up to an industrial shed or tunnel opening. In the doorway, two men in workwear are visible, one standing just inside the shadowed entrance and another on the right flank near mesh-screened doors. A sign is mounted above the portal, suggesting a quarry, civil works site, or storage facility typical of mid-20th-century American infrastructure or resource handling.
